mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logan_device_command (app_id, device_id, action, param, status, operator, note, result_note, deliver_count, add_time, expire_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{deviceId}, #{action}, #{param}, #{status}, #{operator}, #{note}, #{resultNote}, #{deliverCount}, #{addTime}, #{expireTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE logan_device_command SET status = "expired" WHERE status = "pending" AND expire_time <= #{now}
UPDATE logan_device_command SET status = "delivered", delivered_time = #{now}, deliver_count = deliver_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = "pending"
UPDATE logan_device_command SET expire_time = #{expireTime}, status = "pending" WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ("pending","delivered")
UPDATE logan_device_command SET status = "cancelled" WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ("pending","delivered")
UPDATE logan_device_command SET status = "lost", result_note = "delivered but never acked" WHERE status = "delivered" AND delivered_time < #{before}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM logan_device_command WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND device_id = #{deviceId} AND status IN ("pending","delivered")
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logan_device_poll (app_id, device_id, platform, app_version, build_version, sdk_version, last_poll_time, poll_count, add_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{deviceId}, #{platform}, #{appVersion}, #{buildVersion}, #{sdkVersion}, #{now}, 1, #{addTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_poll_time = #{now}, poll_count = poll_count + 1, platform = #{platform}, app_version = #{appVersion}, build_version = #{buildVersion}, sdk_version = #{sdkVersion}
mapper.sql:
FROM ( SELECT app_id, device_id FROM logan_task WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND device_id <> "" GROUP BY app_id, device_id UNION SELECT app_id, device_id FROM logan_crash WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND device_id <> "" GROUP BY app_id, device_id ) d LEFT JOIN ( SELECT app_id, device_id, MAX(platform) AS platform, MAX(crash_time) AS last_crash_time, COUNT(*) AS crash_count, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(brand ORDER BY crash_time DESC SEPARATOR "||"), "||", 1) AS brand, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(model ORDER BY crash_time DESC SEPARATOR "||"), "||", 1) AS model, MAX(sdk_int) AS sdk_int, SUBSTRING_INDEX(GROUP_CONCAT(release_ver ORDER BY crash_time DESC SEPARATOR "||"), "||", 1) AS release_ver FROM logan_crash WHERE app_id = #{appId} GROUP BY app_id, device_id ) c ON c.app_id = d.app_id AND c.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT app_id, device_id, COUNT(*) AS log_count, MAX(add_time) AS last_log_time, MAX(platform) AS platform FROM logan_task WHERE app_id = #{appId} GROUP BY app_id, device_id ) tk ON tk.app_id = d.app_id AND tk.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN logan_device_poll p ON p.app_id = d.app_id AND p.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN logan_device_info di ON di.app_id = d.app_id AND di.device_id = d.device_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT app_id, device_id, COUNT(*) AS pending_commands FROM logan_device_command WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND status IN ("pending","delivered") GROUP BY app_id, device_id ) pc ON pc.app_id = d.app_id AND pc.device_id = d.device_id
AND (d.device_id LIKE CONCAT("%", #{keyword}, "%") OR c.model LIKE CONCAT("%", #{keyword}, "%") OR c.brand LIKE CONCAT("%", #{keyword}, "%"))
mapper.select:
SELECT d.app_id, d.device_id, COALESCE(c.platform, tk.platform, 0) AS platform, (SELECT t.app_version FROM logan_task t WHERE t.app_id = d.app_id AND t.device_id = d.device_id ORDER BY t.add_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS app_version, (SELECT t.build_version FROM logan_task t WHERE t.app_id = d.app_id AND t.device_id = d.device_id ORDER BY t.add_time DESC LIMIT 1) AS build_version, c.brand, c.model, c.sdk_int, c.release_ver, COALESCE(tk.log_count, 0) AS log_count, tk.last_log_time, COALESCE(c.crash_count, 0) AS crash_count, c.last_crash_time, p.last_poll_time, COALESCE(p.poll_count, 0) AS poll_count, COALESCE(pc.pending_commands, 0) AS pending_commands, di.info AS device_info, di.report_time AS device_info_time
ORDER BY GREATEST(COALESCE(p.last_poll_time, 0), COALESCE(tk.last_log_time, 0), COALESCE(c.last_crash_time, 0)) DESC, d.device_id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO logan_device_info (app_id, device_id, platform, info, report_time) VALUES (#{appId}, #{deviceId}, #{platform}, #{info}, #{reportTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE platform = #{platform}, info = #{info}, report_time = #{reportTime}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM logan_device_info WHERE app_id = #{appId} AND device_id = #{deviceId} LIMIT 1
